newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks end surging despite oil price hike.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks end surging despite oil price hike.

text.p: Taiwan share prices surged to a sharply higher close on Monday, ignoring a weekend oil price hike to focus on a bank shareholding liberalisation that was likely to draw new capital into the market, brokers said.
The benchmark index gained 150.13 points or 1.79 percent to 8,517.70, just shy of its session high, for its fourth straight closing gain. Turnover was a very hectic T$185.3 billion.

Monopoly Chinese Petroleum Corp raised Taiwan oil prices an average 2.97 percent on Saturday, a move announced on Friday when financial markets were closed for a holiday, but investors appeared to have taken the increase in stride.
